title: St Mary's gains its pictured belfry
items: An open belfry and cross now rise over St Mary's. A lower roof, five windows and an end door replace the house form, and its one chimney stands toward the far end. These features are reconstructed for 1835 from an undated engraving; the original footprint and dates are retained.
The Images tab shows the credited Moss engraving. Its 1884 publication is distinguished from the undated scene; the provisional comparison camera is not offered as a historical viewpoint.
